description: This is a shell script for testing Git's mergetool functionality, including configuration, invocation, workflows with various conflict scenarios, submodules, and integration with GUI tools.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test case.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the preceded command exits with a failure code.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the specified output is empty.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file for test setup.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository in a specified subdirectory.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or unsets Git configuration parameters.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files, failing the test if they differ.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within the output or files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test script.
